freeze.rule: Frozen by the orchestrator commit that adds this file (with configs/wp12/supported_envelope_v2.json and docs/reports/WP12_PHASE5_FREEZE_DECISION.md), committed unedited. Before that commit it is not in force; after it, any change to seeds, ranges, families, strata, metrics, thresholds, targets, Native rule or budget is benchmark_v2 (a new file), never an edit. Every run records config_sha256 / envelope_sha256 (run_wp12_phase5.meta); a run whose sha256 differs from the committed blob is not a benchmark v1 result. generalization_wp12.validate_benchmark accepts status DRAFT or FROZEN only, so the freeze state is carried here and status is FROZEN.
freeze.freeze_check: generalization_wp12.freeze_problems(load_benchmark('configs/wp12/benchmark_v1.json'), load_envelope('configs/wp12/supported_envelope_v2.json')) == [] (run in the decision); ID_validated samples inside envelope v2 phase5_id_rules and every ID_unconfirmed sample outside them (decision script)
freeze.runner_flags: every command passes --config configs/wp12/benchmark_v1.json --envelope configs/wp12/supported_envelope_v2.json (the runner defaults are the DRAFT and envelope v1)

freeze_notice: FROZEN predeclared WP-12 Phase 5 benchmark (spec 5.1-5.8). No benchmark or held-out seed has been preflighted or run. Development runs (artifacts/wp12/phase5_dev_NNN) used only dev seeds of the DRAFT and are DEV. Order: benchmark split feasibility -> kinematic queue -> summary; held-out feasibility -> Demo 7 selection -> held-out kinematic (once); Native sub-sample of the benchmark split. Held-out seeds are never used for tuning. Kinematic results are kinematic ideal tracking, never live results.

Everything that E2 may validate stays out of ID until E2 passes and a new envelope version is declared.

spec: docs/WP12_SPECIFICATION.md Phase 5 (5.1 families, 5.2 randomization, 5.3 feasibility classes, 5.4 ID/OOD, 5.5 protocol, 5.6 metrics, 5.7 targets, 5.8 mixed operations)
frozen_and_unchanged: tlmpm*.py and law 8, every goals.py threshold (rcs_goal_v1 defaults, snapshot below), goal_eval_v1/v2/v2a, blade_master_flat_board_v1, final_v4, the WP-11 records. The benchmark only composes existing scene and goal types; the solver has no task-specific branch. Also unchanged: configs/wp12/supported_envelope_v1.json, configs/wp12/supported_envelope_v2_PROPOSED.json, configs/wp12/benchmark_v1_DRAFT.json, every E1/E2/V1-V4/resolution record. The tlmpm_v6 candidate is not used by this benchmark.

common.board_rule: Every scene is one continuous cutting board on the table (supports.kind flat_board). The board is CO-ROTATED with the workpiece (cutting_board.yaw_deg = workpiece yaw: flat_board_v1 has no oriented TLMPM fixture boxes) and its centre stays at the record value, so a yaw that turns a board corner past the table edge is scene_geometrically_infeasible. The workpiece z is the board top (flat_board_workcell.place_on_board). Slotted boards only where a family declares board_kind.

slotted_rule.text: Explicit Option D (ADR 0017, E1): one 8 mm wide, 8 mm deep through-width groove under each declared cut plane (its x at the board top), board stays one body.

solver.rule: tlmpm_v5 law 8 for every digit count (packed codes; needed by cut_aware_surface_v1), max_cuts = goal_planner digits_used, slots_per_node 16 (WP-11 round 2: no overflow, max occupancy 8)

duration_rule.text: WP-11 Phase E rule: probe compile, plan end = first DONE knot of the ideal reference schedule, duration = ceil((plan end + 1 s) / 0.5 s) * 0.5 s

dimension_rule.text: WP-11 Phase E rule: lengths and widths to even millimetres, heights (and trim depths) to whole millimetres; raw draws and applied values are both recorded

common.cut_plane_rule: WP-11 Phase E rule: vertical, unyawed sever planes are snapped to solver node planes (multiples of grid_dx_m in the workpiece frame); tilted or yawed planes are not snapped

sever_rule.text: WP-11 Phase E rule: minimum_part_mass_fraction = 0.5 x the smallest nominal piece fraction; every other sever threshold is the goals.py default

board_friction.scope: PhysX knife/robot-board contact only (Native); TLMPM material-board contact always uses the material friction (configs/wp12_workcells_v1.json friction_scope). No effect in kinematic runs; recorded as such.

board_kind.maps_to: cutting_board.kind (+ slots under the cut planes)

cut_order.maps_to: plane order of a multi-plane sever

slice_jitter_m.maps_to: offset of each equal-spacing slice plane

cut_tilt_deg.maps_to: sever normal tilt about local y: the sever-plane tilt theta about the edge line (called tau in E1; NOT the ADR 0013 edge tilt tau, which stays 0); B tilt_slotted (explicit slotted board)

cut_tilt_solid_deg.maps_to: sever-plane tilt theta on the SOLID flat board (B tilt_solid, decision D5 OOD dimension)

cut_plane_yaw_deg.maps_to: sever normal yaw about local z

advance_tilt_deg.maps_to: sever approach_local tilt in the plane

cut_clearance_m.maps_to: planner cut_clearance_m (armed start before the material)

material_profile.spec: Material profile, friction coefficients, mass/density, cutting resistance
material_profile.scope: Only discrete profiles are expressible in rcs_scene_v1: cutting_tasks_v1 and materials_wp12_v1 (Phase 4c, provisional, uncalibrated): soft_elastic / clay_plastic / firm / stiff (material), low/high_friction (friction), light/dense (density), low/high_cut_resistance (cutting resistance). wp12_stiff_v1 is refused at 0.1 ms by the CFL admission rule (physically_unsupported).

unsupported_dimensions.contact_parameters: TLMPM contact stiffness / radius are solver config, not scene data (generalization_wp12.MISSING_FEATURES continuous_physics_overrides)
unsupported_dimensions.continuous_friction_density_cut_resistan: only as discrete materials_wp12_v1 profiles (MISSING_FEATURES continuous_physics_overrides)

workpiece_yaw_deg.note: board co-rotated; corners leave the table beyond about 3.2 deg

length_m.note: flat-board evidence L 50-160 mm (Phase 4c, reference bar); E2 re-declaration

cut_tilt_deg.note: B tilt_slotted only (explicit Option D slotted board): E2 SLOT_m20 / SLOT_p20 CONFIRMED with the planner 4 mm overtravel

cut_tilt_solid_deg.note: BF base draw only (BF has no ID stratum): theta = 0 is the only ID cell on the solid board

cut_plane_yaw_deg.note: B plane_yaw: E2 YAW_m15 / YAW_p15 CONFIRMED

advance_tilt_deg.note: read by no benchmark v1 family (advance_tilt excluded: planner board collision for every beta != 0, E2)

rake_deg.note: flat board through the planner: rho 10 (Native, E2) and 35 (E2 SKIM_r35, removal 0.952: the thinnest E2 margin)

skim_direction.note: DEV finding phase5_dev_001: -x skims (C s53901) and -x chip sweeps (G s57901) are collision/IK infeasible on this workcell, so -x is OOD

push_distance_m.note: fixed at the only validated push distance (E2 CUT_PUSH, WP-11 SLICE-PUSH)

cut_tilt_deg.note: slotted theta (20, 34.9] (envelope sever_tilt_slotted_board; +25 one CONFIRMED point; 32.1 collision_constrained in DEV; 35 known failure outside the bound)

cut_tilt_solid_deg.note: BF boundary study: 0 < |theta| <= 9.9 on the solid board (2 CONFIRMED, 5 KNOWN_FAILURE through the planner, >= 10 KNOWN_FAILURE at h = 0)

material_profile.note: D4/D5 labels: soft_elastic, clay_plastic, firm, light, dense have distinct mechanics; low/high_cut_resistance are force-only variants under law 8 and low/high_friction weak-effect variants: reported as such, never counted as generalization of separation. wp12_stiff_v1 stays in the choice and is classified physically_unsupported (CFL admission at 0.1 ms; excluded from the envelope)

B.name: oblique_direction_varied_cuts
B.note: E2 re-declaration: ID and OOD. tilt_slotted runs on the explicit Option D slotted variant (8 mm groove under the plane at the board top, fixed by the variant, labelled Option D in every report and video), ID |theta| <= 20 (E2 +-20 CONFIRMED), OOD (20, 34.9]; plane_yaw on the solid board, ID |phi| <= 15 (E2 +-15), OOD (15, 35]. Tilted and yawed planes are not node-snapped (random lattice phase: untested interaction, measured here). advance_tilt excluded (planner board collision, E2); tilt_solid moved to family BF (OOD only).

BF.name: flat_board_tilt_boundary
BF.spec: 5.1 B oblique cuts / 5.4 OOD boundary (decision D5 OOD dimension cut_tilt_solid_deg)
BF.note: OOD only, outside every target and never a demo. Measures the flat-board oblique boundary under the real pipeline (path_v2 armed end 0.1-0.3 mm): 2 deg CONFIRMED, 5 deg KNOWN_FAILURE (E2), 5-9.9 deg and negative tilts NOT_RUN. Every executed sample is reported with theta and its armed end; a success at |theta| >= 5 or a failure at |theta| <= 2 is reported as found, never reclassified. seed_base 60000 avoids the H dev OOD seeds (59100-59101).

C.name: near_horizontal_trim
C.note: E2 re-declaration: skim_protrusion and trim_plane_protrusion are both ID_validated (rho 10-35, psi +-10, +x, 20-30 mm/s, dome/gaussian/ellipsoid_cap, height 5-9 mm; E2 TRIM_PLANE removed 0.959). trim_layer removed by D5 (known failure).

E.name: multiple_protrusion_removal
E.note: E2 re-declaration: remove_all, remove_selected, bumps_sequential and trim_trim (E2 TRIM_TRIM 0.970 per step) are ID_validated.

F.name: mixed_sever_trim
F.note: No validated cell (class (c) core-band carry failed 3/6 in WP-11 TEST_D2; envelope v2 PARTIALLY_VALIDATED): ID_unconfirmed stratum, run as declared and reported fully, outside the spec 5.7 targets.

G.name: cut_push_relocation
G.spec: 5.1 G, 5.8 cut->push, trim->clear chip and cut->reposition->cut (sever x1, kerf_face push by d, sever reference x2 = midpoint(x1, L/2) with the opt-in step field planner_offset_local_m [d, 0, 0]; WP-12 Phase 6)
G.note: E2 re-declaration: cut_push is ID_validated (E2 CUT_PUSH; push fixed at 20 mm; ID cut_fraction 0.0-0.2 so the pushed +x piece is 0.3-0.5 L, the validated push masses). trim_clear_chip (NOT_RUN at the formal resolution) and cut_reposition_cut (DEV 4 mm only) stay ID_unconfirmed (outside the spec 5.7 targets).

H.name: shape_pose_support_variation
H.spec: 5.1 H (declares the explicit slotted variant through board_kind)
H.note: Decision D5: vertical sever and skim on the solid or the explicit slotted board (Option D, labelled); board size, thickness and friction (friction acts on PhysX contact only, no kinematic effect).

seeds.rule: seed = family seed_base + split offset + range-set offset + i, i < count; every (family, seed) is unique over splits and range sets (checked at load). Declared seeds keep their declared index (variant = variants[index % len], OOD dimension = ood_dimensions[index % len]). Family BF uses seed_base 60000 (OOD only).

use.dev: research iteration and DEV smokes only (artifacts/wp12/phase5_dev_NNN)
use.benchmark: the formal run, once, after the freeze
use.held_out: run once after the benchmark with the frozen configuration; never used for tuning

sampling.ood_coverage_rule: With one_at_a_time, a family's OOD stratum must reach every declared OOD dimension with its 10 benchmark seeds (generalization_wp12.coverage; freeze_problems blocks otherwise). Dimensions randomized only in ID: C protrusion_family/material_profile, E protrusion_family/radius_x, H workpiece_x/y, board_length, board_friction (PhysX only), protrusion_family; the material OOD axis is family A (and the separate Phase 4c material study). B: tilt_slotted reads cut_tilt_deg, plane_yaw reads cut_plane_yaw_deg (5 OOD samples each). BF: tilt_solid reads cut_tilt_solid_deg (10).
sampling.ood_rule: An OOD sample takes every ID draw and replaces exactly one OOD dimension (ood_dimensions[index % len]) by its OOD range (disjoint from ID by validation), so each OOD outcome is attributable to one dimension (ood_boundary_by_dimension in the summary).

feasibility.checks: 1 scene geometry: generator checks (plane inside the workpiece, plane spacing >= 2 grid cells, separately removed protrusions do not overlap, sever planes miss protrusions where declared) then scene_config validation and compile (SceneInfeasible, flat-board record errors such as a board corner past the table edge, planner geometry errors); 2 supported envelope (configs/wp12/supported_envelope_v2.json; null bounds are NOT_EVALUATED and mark the sample envelope_pending; materials_wp12 CFL admission); 3 motion preflight (generalization.staged_preflight staged_v2: Newton IK, C2 MuJoCo distances, flat-board blade/board rule): IK pose error or joint-limit/continuity -> ik_unreachable, any collision/clearance check -> collision_constrained. The primary class is the first failing class in the precedence; all check results are kept. A config error or a preflight crash is a classification error: reported as not_run with the reason, never dropped.
feasibility.after_execution: valid_feasible -> task_success | execution_failure (solver_invalid, plan_not_finished, integrity, outcome, crash, grasp) | not_run (feasible but not executed: stays in the feasible denominator)

selection.text: Declared before any run: per listed stratum, the first 3 valid_feasible benchmark samples in declared seed order (feasibility classes only, never kinematic outcomes): 8 ID strata (24 episodes) and A_OOD (3: pose/size OOD, where Native-specific reach, tracking and grasp effects concentrate). A stratum with fewer than 3 valid_feasible samples runs what it has and records the shortfall; every unselected sample keeps its reason.

not_selected_strata.status: NOT_RUN in Native by declared budget (decided before the freeze)
not_selected_strata.reason: OOD has no target; the kinematic run measures every OOD dimension on all 10 samples per stratum, while 3 Native samples (one per dimension at best) cannot locate a boundary; BF is a known-failure-dominated boundary study; Native cost is 6-17 min per episode on the single Native GPU, shared with the 14 Phase 7 demo runs.

native.runner: scripts/run_wp12_phase5.py native-launch -> scripts/run_wp10_live.py --runtime isaac_sim --scene/--goal (the WP-12 Phase 2b workcell_live_v1 path: physical grasp, HOME reset, goal planner, measured edge feedback, hold to the time limit, physical return home)

success_definition.source: configs/wp12/workcell_live_v1.json task_success_requires (Phase 2b, amended 2026-10-31 to the stricter WP-11 grasp warning gates)
task_success_requires: goal evaluator verdict PASS (goal_eval_v2a on the live recorded oracle history)
the scripted plan reached DONE within the episode (task_end_reason CONTROLLER_DONE)
finite recorded material state and no solver error
no GRASP_FAILURE in the task phase (slip > 0.002 m or rotation > pi/60 rad: grasp_monitor warning gates)
no IK_FAILURE in the task phase (any IK status other than ok, or any workspace-clamped command)
success_definition.classifier: scripts/run_wp12_workcell_live_analysis.py (GL.classify_live with GRASP_GATES and the IK / clamp counts) on the attempt directory
success_definition.mapping: classify_live TASK_SUCCESS -> task_success; GRASP_FAILURE -> execution_failure grasp; IK_FAILURE (IK not ok, workspace clamp, or a Native plan-preflight IK refusal) and a SCENE_INFEASIBLE refusal -> execution_failure other (reason kept); CUTTING_FAILURE 'solver state invalid' -> solver_invalid, 'plan did not finish' -> plan_not_finished, 'integrity' -> integrity, 'outcome' -> outcome; a LAUNCHED attempt without an episode result (classify_live NOT_RUN) -> execution_failure crash; only a selected sample never launched is not_run (it stays in the feasible denominator)
success_definition.status: DECLARED. run_wp12_phase5.native_execution is PROVISIONAL and less strict (no grasp gates, no IK/clamp counts, preflight refusal -> not_run): it must be replaced by this definition, CPU-tested against the Phase 2b records (workcell_live_001-007 classes reproduced), before the first Native benchmark episode; until then no Native benchmark episode runs.
success_definition.home_outcome: reported separately (HOME reset and physical return), never part of task success

budget.basis: Phase 2b Native process wall: CUT 6.4, TRIM 5.9, Test C 10.7, Test B 16.6 min; one run at a time on GPU 0

kinematic.runner: scripts/run_wp12_phase5.py kinematic (one sample per process) / queue (resumable: a sample whose output directory exists is skipped and preserved)

task_outcome.target_removal_fraction: remove/trim: min removed mass fraction over selected protrusions or the region (generalization.episode_metrics cut_completion)
task_outcome.piece_displacement: move_piece displacement along the direction and the other pieces' maximum displacement
task_outcome.cutting_location_error: frozen 2 mm midpoint statistic (grid-aligned) or actual - ideal swept-plane statistic (oblique)
task_outcome.goal_completion: goal evaluator verdict (goal_eval_v2a integrity / outcome / quality layers)

physical_quality.substrate_retention: min substrate share over removal steps
physical_quality.remaining_unwanted_bridges: failed separation checks and component count vs expected
physical_quality.contact_stability: finite state, min det F, max particle speed (sampled every 10 control steps)
physical_quality.knife_grasp_stability: Native only (grasp monitor); NOT_APPLICABLE in kinematic runs
physical_quality.penetration: particles below the rigid board top, min local z, workspace-clamped control steps
physical_quality.physical_cutting_validity: evaluation integrity layer and solver validity (slot overflow, non-finite state)

runtime.gpu_memory: process GPU memory (nvidia-smi) at the end

reliability.multi_episode_stability: Phase 6 (repeated episodes per env); here: every sample is a fresh process
reliability.recorded_output_validity: result.json, manifest.json and actions.jsonl present and parseable
reliability.reproducibility: declared repeats: the first valid_feasible ID sample of each family rerun once on the other device; verdict and component count compared

metrics.mixed_operation_checks_status: 'no accidental reconnection' (per-step component count from the recorded history) and the declared reproducibility repeats (--repeat) are declared but not built: built before the kinematic queue ends, else reported NOT_RUN; neither gates task success (goal_eval_v2a decides)

thresholds.source: Each goal's declared thresholds: the rcs_goal_v1 defaults of goals.py (_TYPE_FIELDS) unchanged, plus the WP-11 Phase E sever_rule for minimum_part_mass_fraction (common.sever_rule). The snapshot below is checked against goals.py by the CPU tests; any drift blocks the freeze.

targets.other: No silent solver failures, no false-positive task success, no hidden sample exclusion (summaries assert every declared sample is counted once). OOD has no target: the boundary is measured.
targets.statistics: Point estimate and Wilson 95 % lower bound are both reported (met_point, met_lower_bound). With about 60 feasible ID_validated benchmark samples the lower bound reaches 0.90 only at >= 59/60; per stratum (n <= 10) 10/10 gives [0.72, 1]. The Native target (about 19 ID_validated episodes) is a point-estimate engineering target (19/19 gives [0.83, 1]). Held-out results are reported separately against the same targets.

target_scope.rule: Decisions D5 and E2 re-declaration: the spec 5.7 targets are computed over ID samples of validated cells only (population ID_validated = every ID sample except those listed here; envelope v2 phase5_id_rules). ID_unconfirmed samples are declared, preflighted, run and reported with the same tables and Wilson intervals, but never enter a target; the split is fixed by this file and never changed after results. BF has no ID stratum.

declared_exclusions.what: B advance_tilt (slanted chop) on the flat board
declared_exclusions.status: KINEMATICALLY_INFEASIBLE with the current planner for every beta != 0 (edge centre stops on the board top, low edge end 60 mm x sin(beta) inside the board)
declared_exclusions.consequence: not declared as samples (every sample would be collision_constrained by geometry); reported in WP12_GENERALIZATION.md as a declared exclusion and in the acceptance matrix as a planner limitation
removed by D5; not a sample class

declared_exclusions.what: -x skims and -x chip sweeps in ID
declared_exclusions.status: collision / IK infeasible on this workcell (DEV phase5_dev_001/002)

id_justification.rule: Each ID dimension is a validated cell of envelope v2 (both ends confirmed, or a single fixed value) or a dimension the physics provably does not see; the interior of a range is covered by the stated mechanism, not by sampling.
id_justification.pose: workpiece x +-20 / y +-10 mm, yaw +-2 deg: the solver runs in the workpiece-local frame on the co-rotated board, so separation physics is pose-invariant (Phase 4c G19 translated, G20 yaw 30 co-rotated); reach is classified by the motion preflight, never assumed
id_justification.size: L 140-160 (Phase 4c 50-150, reference bar 160), W 26-34 (4c 12-48), H 16-24 mm (4c 12-32 with path_v2 inside the window; H <= 10 is the v1 failure region)
id_justification.protrusions: dome / gaussian / ellipsoid_cap, 1-3, radii 9-13 x 9-11.5 mm, height 5-9 mm (decision D5 cells: 4c G11-G13, Native Test C 12 x 12 x 8, E2 dome 12 x 10 x 8; the skim happens at z = H, away from the board)
id_justification.board: length 300-360, width 170-190, thickness 15-25 mm, friction 0.25-0.45, solid or slotted (H): TLMPM sees only the board-top plane (local z = 0) and uses the material friction; board friction is PhysX-only; slotted vertical sever at 4 mm below the bottom validated (Phase 2a D8_M400)
id_justification.cut_location: vertical node-plane severs at cut_fraction +-0.2 (A, D, H), +-0.15 (B), +-0.08 (F): location-invariant in the local frame (Native Test B planes at +-0.1 / +-0.3 L); G 0.0-0.2 keeps the pushed piece at the validated 0.3-0.5 L
id_justification.cut_count_order: 2-3 planes, ascending / descending / shuffled, jitter +-3 mm (Native Test B 4 cuts; MULTI2 at every resolution)
id_justification.approach: cut clearance 6-10 mm: arming in air before contact has no material effect (law 8 labels only swept material)
id_justification.speeds: cut 8-12, skim 20-30 mm/s: E2 both ends plus the default in the middle; quasi-static; the through-cut armed end is set by the 0.3 mm path_v2 tolerance
id_justification.orientation: rho 10-35, psi +-10 (E2 both ends on the flat board); slotted theta +-20 (E2 both ends; vertical slotted D8_M400); plane yaw +-15 (E2 both ends); solid tilt 0; advance tilt 0
id_justification.uncertainty: Each validated end is ONE kinematic run (seed 42, the 160 x 30 x 20 mm bar, one lattice phase; tilted rows through a node line at the board top). 1/1 bounds the per-sample success probability only to [0.21, 1] (Wilson 95 %); dimensions were confirmed one at a time, so their interactions (e.g. slotted 20 deg at 12 mm/s on a 24 mm bar at a random lattice phase, rho 35 on three bumps at 30 mm/s) are untested and are what this benchmark measures. Known thin margins: through-cut armed end 0.16-0.28 mm vs the 0.375 mm window (about 0.1 mm), rho 35 removal 0.952 vs 0.9, skim 30 mm/s 0.961, slotted handle slack 2.52 mm at 20 deg. An ID failure is reported as an ID failure: never moved to OOD, never reclassified, never fixed in v1 (a change of cell is envelope v3 / benchmark v2).
